body:
Hey Julius,

Just wanted to touch base regarding the Security Awareness Training RFP we discussed. I hope everything’s going well on your end. We’re all set to move forward with the procurement process, and just need you to register on our supplier portal to access the full details. It should only take a couple of minutes.

Let me know if you have any questions or if there’s anything else you’d like to add before we proceed.

Looking forward to your response!

Best,
Markus

events.reply: Hey Markus, thanks for the ping, and good to hear it's moving! Sorry, I'm on the road a lot and have a lot of RFPs running, so remind me: who's my main contact on your procurement side? And what's the scope (number of employees, which modules) and the timeline for the decision? Once I know that, I'll take a look at the portal.

subject: Auriga Retail Group — RFP-2026-118: supplier portal access
body:
Hi Julius,

Hope you're doing well. Just a quick reminder that the next step for RFP-2026-118 is to register on our Auriga Retail Group supplier portal. This will give you access to the full RFP package for the "Security Awareness Training" program.

If you need any details or have any questions, feel free to ask. You can register using this link: https://suppliers.auriga-retail.com/register

Looking forward to your proposal.

Best,
Markus Reiner
Head of Procurement
Auriga Retail Group

events.reply:
Hi Markus,

Thanks. I had a quick look at the portal page, and ~4,200 people across 96 stores with SMS/WhatsApp sounds right up our alley. Before I register, two things from my last note are still open: how did this RFP come to us (who at Auriga talked to us, and when)? And can you tell me how the decision process runs after the 12 December deadline? A short call on Monday would also work for me.

Best,
Julius

body:

As for who signs off at the end, it will be a decision made collectively by the evaluation team: myself, Dr. Katrin Vogt, and Stefanie Auer. Let’s do that quick call you mentioned—how does 10 AM tomorrow work for you?

Looking forward to chatting.

Best,
Markus
